intent: Closed. All twelve records that nothing cited are now cited. Eight went to packs/agentic-development and four to packs/delivery-testing, in each pack's research organ, recording what each source settles and why no binding requirement rests on it. They were not bolted onto existing sentences: EV-0014 and EV-0054 are the progressive-disclosure contract this estate's own activation model claims to be, seen from outside; EV-0042 and EV-0072 put a date on the assumption that the harness boundary stays local; EV-0047 and EV-0049 are exemplars of durability mechanisms the estate does not have; EV-0013 is the observability standard the pack prefers but cannot bind while the benchmark measures from transcripts; EV-0073 is the harness-aware benchmarking standard this estate's own benchmark fell short of. The four in delivery-testing (EV-0002, EV-0031, EV-0032, EV-0033) all measure test-generation ability, which is what the oracle-first requirement depends on, so leaving them uncited left that requirement resting on argument alone. Check S016 holds the count at zero.
